title: Orbit Board v1.3.9 (Constellation Web, Bengali Ergonomics & Typography Polish)
changelog: 🌌 New Typing Effect: Constellation Web — Dynamic cyber threads and glowing Nothing Red nodes
🫧 Calibrated Bubble Burst: Reduced particle count to 20 with refined 2.6–5.4px radius for focused, tactile feedback
🌐 Minimal Language Dialog: Dynamic wrap-content sizing with 20dp Bauhaus rounded corners, eliminating empty space
🇧🇩 Probhat Ergonomics: Long-press 'র' brings 'ড়' in center, '্র' (ro-phola) on the right, and 'র্' (reph) on the left
🔤 Typography & Font Upgrades: Full Agency FB font with lowercase support; Qurova numeral demo logo glitch resolved
⚡ 120Hz Zero-Allocation Loop: Butter-smooth 120Hz display responsiveness with zero GC allocations
🔒 100% Offline & Private: Zero network permissions, complete on-device keystroke privacy
